_about: One per talk, in the talk's folder next to its two HTML files. `overrides` changes brand.json `decks` settings for this talk only (same keys, e.g. {"mainstage": {"max_words": 7}}). `slides` is written by the fidelity step: the export treatment chosen per slide, keyed by 1-based slide number as a string, one of "editable", "glow-behind" or "picture". A slide not listed is asked about, or gets the default.
title: Your talk
